secondaryValue: Never play, Play when relevant, Always play
fieldDescription: Plays when the harpoon restores a charge. Relevant means while the breach lamps are lit or the fleet is close to an open pond.

Centers the viewport on an opening pond to make skillshot aiming easier. Turning this off leaves the camera under manual control; aiming will be harder and the extra motion may be uncomfortable for players sensitive to it.
Adds a Fisherman dialogue option to skip the tutorial before you start it. Has no effect after the tutorial begins.
